name: Basic Tax Law
source:
Does the IRS have you down this year? Can't understand the Federal Tax Code? Do you enjoy cute puppy pictures? If you answered "yes", then Basic Tax Law is the game for you!

In this game, Barky Budget the Dog Auditor, explains basic tax law. He goes through every line of the Form 1040 step by step, simplifying the difficult parts for beginners, and offering optional explanations for those who want to learn more about advanced topics.

[From [url=https://arglefumph.itch.io/basic-tax-law]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今年报税让你焦头烂额吗？看不懂联邦税法吗？喜欢可爱的小狗照片吗？如果你的回答都是“是”，那么《Basic Tax Law》就是为你准备的游戏！

在游戏中，狗审计员巴奇·巴吉特会讲解基本税法。他逐行讲解1040表格，简化对初学者来说困难的部分，并为想了解更多高级主题的人提供可选说明。

[来源：[url=https://arglefumph.itch.io/basic-tax-law]itch.io[/url]]
